perplexity.description:
Doperider is the third album by The Utopia Strong, the improvisational trio of snooker legend Steve Davis, guitarist Kavus Torabi, and multi-instrumentalist Mike York, released on Rocket Recordings in October 2025. Drawing inspiration from Paul Kirchner's surreal comic character Dope Rider—a skeletal biker navigating cosmic realms—the album channels psychonaut voyages through hypnotic electronics, expansive psychedelia, and abstract noise, evoking influences from Zeuhl pioneers like Magma, contemporary Polish cosmic ensembles such as Alameda 5, and synth visionaries like Caterina Barbieri and Laurie Spiegel. Its seven tracks, including the intense title opener "Doperider," the elegiac "Unity of Light," and the blissful "Harpies" featuring manipulated vocals by Katharine Blake of Mediæval Bæbes, unfold as evolving instrumental suites that shift from twisting bleeps and modular synth pulses to sweeping keys and desert rhythms.

The band's serendipitous studio process, fueled by art books and innate chemistry, yields a trippy descent into "beautiful hell holes," blending coruscating intensity with melancholic rapture while incorporating Davis's growing prowess in abstract electronica and musique concrète. Critics hail it as the group's wildest and most immersive work yet, pushing beyond Krautrock roots into uncharted territories that reward deep listens with transformative, mind-altering detail—music designed to simulate a drug trip without the hangover, urging listeners toward self-discovery. A repress followed in January 2026 due to demand, underscoring its significance in the electronic-psych landscape.
